purpose: Section 11: frozen operational rubric for the 3 independent blinded adjudicators, covering all 5 atomic dimensions and the 10 permanent invariants. Frozen before any adjudication.
howToUseThisRubric: For each ground-truth claim x candidate-pool evidence packet, assign each of the 5 dimensions independently. A dimension's value must be justified against ITS OWN necessary/exclusion conditions below - do not let your answer on one dimension pressure your answer on another (e.g. do not downgrade evidenceQuality merely because creditEligibility is NO_CREDIT). Apply the 10 invariants as hard constraints: if your assignment would violate one, reconsider.

necessaryConditionsForCredit: At least one candidate has been compiled into a structured representation (not merely an inventory mention).

That candidate corresponds to THIS SPECIFIC ground-truth claim's own identity - same action, same posture, same object/resource - not merely the same covenant family, section, defined term, or economic topic.
No material dimension the claim depends on (a specific threshold, condition, exception, entity scope) is missing or conflicting.
exclusionConditions: The candidate is anchored at a DIFFERENT enumerated sub-item under the same parent section (a sibling) - this can never establish CREDIT, however much vocabulary it shares. Same-claim identity is a HARD PRECONDITION, checked before completeness.

The candidate is merely a partial/incomplete representation of this same claim (that is still NO_CREDIT for this dimension, even though it is a real, non-trivial partial achievement - see representationCompleteness for that).

dimensionB_surfacingStatus.applicability: Assign NOT_APPLICABLE whenever your own creditEligibility answer for this same case is CREDIT. Only assign SPECIFICALLY_SURFACED or NOT_SPECIFICALLY_SURFACED when creditEligibility=NO_CREDIT.
necessaryConditionsForSpecificallySurfac: A candidate that corresponds to THIS SPECIFIC claim (same identity test as dimension A - not a sibling, not a same-family neighbor) explicitly shows: review is required, OR semantics are unresolved, OR support is insufficient, OR the claim cannot safely be represented, OR an equivalent claim-specific uncertainty.
exclusionConditions: A generic warning that does not name or anchor to this specific claim does not count.
A warning on a same-section, same-family, or sibling-claim candidate does not count, however prominent or numerous.
Structural proximity (nearby text, same document area) does not count without an actual claim-specific declaration.

dimensionC_representationCompleteness.applicabilityNote: Assign this dimension for every case, regardless of creditEligibility - it is a separate, additive fact about how much of the claim's structure the BEST available same-claim candidate covers, not a re-statement of the credit decision.
necessaryConditionsForFull: A same-claim candidate covers every material semantic dimension the claim depends on, with no conflicts.
necessaryConditionsForPartial: Same-claim identity is affirmatively established (the candidate is genuinely about THIS claim, not a sibling or a different claim in the same family).
At least one material semantic dimension is missing or incomplete.
exclusionConditions: PARTIAL never means 'a related, nearby, or sibling claim was represented instead' - that is NONE for this claim, with the sibling's own completeness (if it has its own ground-truth unit) evaluated separately.

If the best available candidate materially CONTRADICTS the claim (asserts a wrong answer) rather than merely omitting a piece of it, assign NONE here (the contradiction lives in verificationStatus=CONTRADICTED, not in a completeness score for the wrong content).

dimensionD_verificationStatus.coreRule: Only use a verification state OTHER THAN NOT_EVALUATED when the evidence packet contains an ACTUAL, explicit verification-layer finding (a verifierFindings-style entry) about the candidate that represents this claim, OR the ground-truth comparison itself reveals a material contradiction. Do not infer verification happened just because a representation looks confident or complete.
necessaryConditionsForVerified: An explicit verification finding exists on the same-claim representing candidate AND it is a clean confirmation with no contradicting or incomplete finding.
necessaryConditionsForContradicted: An explicit verification finding contradicts the representation, OR the representation itself materially contradicts the ground-truth claim (a wrong assertion, not a mere omission).
necessaryConditionsForVerificationIncomp: A verification attempt exists but its own finding is inconclusive/ambiguous.
dimensionD_verificationStatus.defaultWhenNoEvidenceExists: NOT_EVALUATED - never invent a distinction the evidence packet does not support. Do not use NOT_VERIFIED unless you have affirmative evidence that verification was attempted and produced nothing, as distinct from verification simply never being attempted at all (which is NOT_EVALUATED).

dimensionE_evidenceQuality.meaning: How clear and complete is the AVAILABLE evidence (both the ground-truth claim's own anchoring and the candidate pool) for making the other 4 determinations confidently - not a restatement of any of them.
necessaryConditionsForSufficient: The ground-truth claim itself is clearly anchored to specific source text, and the candidate evidence (whatever its content) is clear enough to confidently assess correspondence.
necessaryConditionsForAmbiguous: The ground-truth claim's own anchoring is unclear/contested, OR the candidate evidence itself is genuinely open to more than one reasonable reading.
necessaryConditionsForInsufficient: The ground-truth claim's own anchoring is effectively unresolvable from the evidence given, OR there is materially too little evidence (of any kind) to make a confident determination at all.
exclusionConditions: evidenceQuality does not by itself grant or deny credit, and does not by itself count as safe surfacing - it is metadata about confidence, evaluated independently of the other 4 dimensions' own values.

permanentInvariants.statement: Generic uncertainty does not prevent dangerous silence.
A sibling warning does not prevent dangerous silence.
A same-family candidate does not establish claim identity.
NO_CREDIT + NOT_SPECIFICALLY_SURFACED = dangerous silent omission for a material ground-truth claim.
NO_CREDIT + SPECIFICALLY_SURFACED is a safe failure, not substantive credit.
Verification cannot be inferred from semantic representation alone.
Evidence ambiguity cannot independently grant credit.

requiredOutputPerCase.rationale: 1-4 sentences per dimension where non-obvious, naming the specific rubric condition applied
